notes: «قال علي لابن عباس» — Ali is the speaker whose words relay the ban, so he is the last link; Ibn Abbas is the addressee, not a link
«أبيهما» is a bare relation (the father is not named here), kept as relation
«قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع» and «واللفظ له» are glosses; the word «عليه» is why «علي» is occurrence 2
